research_page.title: FDA Prescribing Information: Kisunla (donanemab)
research_page.description: FDA prescribing information for Kisunla (donanemab), detailing efficacy, finite dosing guidelines, and boxed warnings for amyloid-related imaging abnormalities.
research_page.takeaway_md: Kisunla (donanemab) is FDA-approved for early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease, showing a statistically significant slowing of clinical decline over 76 weeks. It introduces a finite dosing model where infusions stop once plaques clear, but it carries a severe boxed warning for ARIA, which is especially risky for ApoE ε4 homozygotes.
key_findings_md: Donanemab significantly slowed decline on the iADRS by 2.92 points and CDR-SB by 0.70 points (29%) over 76 weeks compared to placebo (FDA label, Section 14).
Brain amyloid plaque was robustly cleared, showing a -86.4 Centiloid difference versus placebo at week 76 (FDA label, Table 7).
Amyloid-Related Imaging Abnormalities (ARIA) occurred in 36% of treated patients versus 14% on placebo (FDA label, Section 5.1).
ApoE ε4 homozygotes face the highest risk of ARIA at 55%, compared to 36% for heterozygotes and 25% for noncarriers (FDA label, Section 5.1).
research_page.methods_md: The prescribing information relies heavily on Study 1 (TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 2, [NCT04437511](/trials/trailblazer-alz-2)), a 76-week double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 trial enrolling 1,736 patients with early Alzheimer's disease and confirmed amyloid pathology.
research_page.trial_evidence_md: The FDA approval is rooted in the pivotal Phase 3 [TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 2](/trials/trailblazer-alz-2) trial, which successfully replicated efficacy signals from the Phase 2 TRAILBLAZER-ALZ study. A minor reporting discrepancy flagged by the analyst regarding 72 weeks of dosing versus a 76-week endpoint accurately reflects the trial's formal protocol, which included a 4-week observation period before the final primary assessment.
research_page.sentiment_md: Public perception is sharply divided. Retail investors and mainstream media enthusiastically highlight the finite dosing model and top-line efficacy percentages. In contrast, caregiver and neurology communities express skepticism, questioning whether a 0.70-point absolute CDR-SB improvement justifies the intense [logistical burdens and ARIA risks](https://www.reddit.com/r/medicine/comments/what_do_you_think_about_donanemab/).
caveats_md: The highly promoted finite dosing model is not a permanent fix; plaque accumulation definitively resumes once infusions stop.
While the relative 29% slowing of decline dominates headlines, patients still experience progressive, absolute cognitive loss during the treatment period.
Safety monitoring is extremely burdensome, requiring at least five MRI scans in the first year to monitor for potentially fatal brain hemorrhages.
relates_to_md: [TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 3](/trials/trailblazer-alz-3) — Ongoing Phase 3 prevention trial testing donanemab in preclinical AD.
[Amyloid hypothesis](/research/amyloid-hypothesis) — The theoretical basis for amyloid-targeting monoclonal antibodies like donanemab.

trial_pages.title: TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 2
trial_pages.description: Pivotal Phase 3 trial of donanemab in participants with early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease.
trial_pages.primary_endpoint: Change From Baseline on the Integrated Alzheimer's Disease Rating Scale (iADRS)
trial_pages.why_md: Evaluates the clinical efficacy and safety of donanemab to clear amyloid plaques in early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease. It tests a finite dosing model where treatment stops once plaques are sufficiently reduced on PET imaging.
status_log_md: **2024-07-02** — FDA approves donanemab (Kisunla) based on trial data.
trial_pages.results_md: Donanemab significantly slowed clinical progression at 76 weeks compared to placebo, showing a 2.92-point improvement on the iADRS score and a 0.70-point improvement on CDR-SB. It robustly cleared brain amyloid plaque, though 36% of treated patients experienced ARIA.

notes_for_editor: No new timeline entries were created because the approval of donanemab (Kisunla) in 2024-07 already exists in the timeline.
